summary: EpicQuest Education Group International Ltd filed an unaudited Form 6-K containing condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026, and an operating and financial review. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes disclosed; the filing solely provides financial updates and is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms or strategic actions are discussed beyond standard financial reporting.
